name: CelebFaces Attributes Dataset (CelebA)
description: CelebFaces Attributes Dataset (CelebA) is a widely recognized face attribute dataset containing 202,599 aligned and cropped face images of 10,177 celebrity identities. Each image is annotated with 40 binary facial attribute labels (including eyeglasses, smiling, hair color, and facial hair) and 5 facial landmark locations, supporting face attribute recognition, landmark localization, and generative modeling research.
